source.source_text: jñānopāsye mahājñāne jñeyarūpe namo'stu te | kriyārūpe mahārūpe viśvarūpe namo'stu te —

T1.close_translation: "[and]-O-worshipped-by-the-knowledge, O-great-knowledge, O-knowable-formed, homage-be-to-you; O-action-formed (kriyā-rūpe), O-great-formed, O-all-world-formed (viśva-rūpe), homage-be-to-you:" "[and]-O-the-cessation-end-of-the-being-and-non-being (*?), O-all-absence, homage-be-to-you; O-stationed-in-the-midst-of-the-bliss-step, O-the-end-of-the-appearance (*?), homage-be-to-you; O-the-womb-of-the-delight-step, indeed, O-pervasion-formed, homage-be-to-you:"
